text: Every Thursday before sunrise the square behind the old railway station fills with vans.

The repair workshop in the cellar of the community hall opens on the first Saturday of each month. Visitors bring bicycles with bent wheels, toasters that no longer heat and lamps with loose wiring. The volunteers do not take the work over. They hand the visitor a screwdriver and explain each step. About two thirds of the items leave the cellar working again, and the rest are stripped for spare parts.
